column1: # Escrita stem fixture, Portuguese (pt-BR), "word" profile (echoes: would a reader call these the same word?).
# One pair per line, tab-separated: the two words must produce different stem keys.

# Source: written by hand from linguistic judgment (inflection, gender and number, diminutives and augmentatives, adverbs, clitics) before any stemmer code existed. Not tuned to code, not copied from NLTK, Snowball or any corpus.
# Pairs and groups are chosen from common vocabulary; the spec is docs/PLAN-0.5.md Q1-Q6 and tasks 1.1 and 1.2.
# Rows are frozen (docs/PLAN-0.5.md, Ownership rules): later tasks may add rows, never change or delete one. A row that looks wrong goes to the author (gate G3).
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are comments.
